root.name: トッツィー・ロール・インダストリーズ

relations.text: 製品売上の約22%を占める最大顧客
relations.text_en: Largest customer, about 22% of net product sales

source.label: トッツィー 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our net product sales from Wal-Mart Stores, Inc. (“Wal-Mart”) aggregated approximately 22.0%, 23.2%, and 22.2% of net product sales during the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

relations.text: 製品売上の約13%を占める主要顧客
relations.text_en: Major customer, about 13% of net product sales

source.label: トッツィー 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our net sales from Dollar Tree, Inc. (“Dollar Tree”, which includes net sales from Family Dollar which is owned by Dollar Tree) 4 Table of Contents aggregated approximately 13.1%, 12.6%, and 14.2% of net product sales during the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

relations.text: ウォルマートなどへ製品を届ける食品卸(主要顧客)
relations.text_en: Grocery wholesaler that delivers its products to Wal-Mart and others (major customer)

source.label: トッツィー 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Some of the aforementioned sales to Wal-Mart and Dollar Tree were sold to McLane Company (“McLane”), a large national grocery wholesaler, which services and delivers certain of the Company’s products to Wal-Mart, Dollar Tree and other retailers in the U.S.A.

relations.text: 2004年に買収した「ダブルバブル」のガムメーカー
relations.text_en: Maker of Dubble Bubble gum, acquired in 2004

source.label: トッツィー・ロール 2004年度年次報告書(10-K付属) 10-K付属の契約(2004年度)
source.label_en: Tootsie Roll 2004 annual report (filed with its 10-K) agreement filed with its 10-K (FY2004)
source.quote: in August we purchased Concord Confections, maker of Dubble Bubble, to our knowledge the largest maker of bubble gum in the world.
